def compute_span(array, start_index, max_time):
    length = 1
    for k in range(start_index + 1, len(array)):
        if array[k] - array[start_index] > max_time:
            break
        length += 1
    return length

def main():
    values = []
    count = int(input())
    for _ in range(count):
        val = int(input())
        values.append(val)
    max_time = int(input())
    values.sort()
    max_length = 0
    for i in range(len(values)):
        current_span = compute_span(values, i, max_time)
        if current_span > max_length:
            max_length = current_span
    print(max_length)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
